text:
Ana: Heads-up — I'm opening a small PR to tidy the onboarding walkthrough (auth + first deploy). Consolidating snippets and fixing a broken link to the deploy guide. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3211. Can folks do a quick sanity-check on the examples? :seedling:
Mike: Looking now. Quick Q — did you change the Python example import? I see `from redwood import Client` vs `from redwood import InferenceClient` in other examples. Which do we want to standardize on?
Irene: I ran the python snippet locally, failing because the env var in the doc is `REDWOOD_API_KEY` but the sample app reads `REDWOOD_KEY`. We should standardize on one name so new users don't get stuck.
Sam: I reproduced a lint/logic issue in the JS example — missing `await client.generate(...)` in the async flow. Also the code fence is marked `javascript` but includes TS types, which confuses the highlight.
Docs CI: build started for docs PR #3211 — running site build and linkcheck.
Ana: Good catches. I will: update the python import to `InferenceClient` and standardize the env var to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`; fix the JS await and remove TS types from the JS snippet; add an example `--region` flag in the deploy command.
Mike: For the deploy section, can we include a short `--region` example? A lot of EU customers hit defaults and then hit rate limits. Suggest adding `--region eu-west-1` in the CLI snippet.
Irene: Also the link to the private deployment page 404s — the slug changed from `/private/` to `/private-deploy/`. We need either a redirect or update the link in the quickstart.
Ana: Pushed a small commit that addresses env var, python import, and the JS await: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/8a7c1f. I left the redirect fix as a separate follow-up since it touches the platform redirects file.
Sam: Approving the JS changes. Left a tiny nit about wording: change "first deployment" -> "initial deployment" in one spot for consistency with the CLI reference.
Mike: I'll approve after the redirect is sorted. Docs CI: build finished — linkcheck flagged the missing private-deploy link but site build otherwise succeeded (netlify/12345). :white_check_mark:
Ana: Thanks all — merging once CI is green. I'll also open a follow-up PR to add a smoke test curl snippet to the end of the quickstart, something like:
```
# quick health check after deploy
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://your-app.example.com/health
```
Ana: If anyone wants to add a short automated step to run that as part of the sample app repo CI, ping me and I can coordinate. :sparkles:
